item.title: Recognition and celebration of technical staff in geoscience
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02041-x

Efforts to better recognize technical staff within academia are gaining momentum, but further changes — such as clearer career pathways, stable funding, and greater inclusion in research leadership — are needed to future-proof their role in advancing geosciences.
